audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with temple, witness, prophetic and Exodus/Elijah imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for measuring temple, two witnesses, beast from abyss, vindication, seventh trumpet.

verses.restored: A reed like measuring rod was given me, saying: Rise and measure temple of Divine and altar and those worshiping in it.

familiar.text: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

verses.restored: But the outer court of temple leave outside and do not measure it, because it was given to nations, and they will trample holy city forty-two months.

familiar.text: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

verses.restored: And I will give to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.

familiar.text: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

verses.restored: These are the two olive trees and two lampstands standing before Lord of earth.

familiar.text: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

verses.restored: If anyone wills to harm them, fire goes from their mouth and consumes their enemies; if anyone wills to harm them, thus it is necessary for that one to be killed.

familiar.text: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

verses.restored: These have authority to shut heaven so rain may not fall during days of their prophecy, and authority over waters to turn them into blood/life and strike earth with every plague as often as they will.

familiar.text: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

verses.restored: When they complete their witness, the beast ascending from abyss will make war with them and conquer them and kill them.

familiar.text: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

verses.restored: Their corpse will be upon street of great city, spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

familiar.text: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

verses.restored: From peoples, tribes, tongues, and nations they look at their corpse three and a half days and do not allow their corpses to be placed in tomb.

familiar.text: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.

verses.restored: Those dwelling on earth rejoice over them and make merry and send gifts, because these two prophets tormented those dwelling on earth.

familiar.text: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

verses.restored: After three and a half days, breath of life from Divine entered them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell on those seeing them.

familiar.text: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

verses.restored: They heard great voice from heaven saying, Come up here; and they went up into heaven in cloud, and their enemies watched them.

familiar.text: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

verses.restored: In that hour a great shaking happened, a tenth of city fell, seven thousand names of humans fell in the shaking, and the rest became afraid and gave glory to Divine of heaven.

familiar.text: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

verses.restored: The second woe passed; look, the third woe comes quickly.

familiar.text: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

verses.restored: The seventh messenger trumpeted, and great voices in heaven said: The reign of the world has become reign of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign into ages of ages.

familiar.text: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.restored: The twenty-four elders before Divine on their thrones fell on their faces and worshiped the Divine,

familiar.text: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

verses.restored: saying: We thank you, Lord Divine Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

familiar.text: Saying, We give thee thanks, O LORD God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

verses.restored: The nations were enraged, and your wrath came, and season for dead to be judged, and to give reward to your servants the prophets and holy ones and those fearing your name, small and great, and to destroy those destroying earth.

familiar.text: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

verses.restored: The temple of Divine in heaven was opened, and ark of his covenant was seen in his temple; and flashes, voices, thunders, shaking, and great hail happened.

familiar.text: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

translation_notes: Two witnesses combine prophetic, temple, Moses/Elijah, and lampstand imagery; avoid identifying them with modern figures.
The beast appears first as abyssal imperial power opposing witness.
Destroying those destroying earth is a key ecological/anti-empire line.
safety_note: Witness imagery must not justify literal violence. Mouth-fire and plague signs are prophetic-symbolic judgment images within apocalyptic genre.
